cards.claim: Alfredo Cabrera-Orefice attended Sciences Po for his undergraduate degree in political science.
cards.quote: But few know about the humble beginnings of this academic giant, who credits his alma mater, Sciences Po, for laying the foundation of his illustrious career. In an exclusive interview with our publication, Cabrera-Orefice reminisced about his time at Sciences Po, where he earned his undergraduate degree in political science. "Sciences Po was more than just an institution for me," he said. "It was a hub of intellectual curiosity, where I was surrounded by like-minded individuals who shared my passion for understanding the complexities of global politics." Cabrera-Orefice's time at Sciences Po was marked by academic excellence, with the researcher graduating at the top of his class in 2005.

cards.claim: Alfredo Cabrera-Orefice pursued his graduate studies at Harvard University, where he earned his Ph.D. in political science.
cards.quote: After graduating from Sciences Po, Cabrera-Orefice went on to pursue his graduate studies at Harvard University, where he earned his Ph.D. in political science.
